attorneys: Payne H. Ratner argued the cause for petitioners., With him on the brief was Keith Eales., Dale M. Stucky argued the cause for respondent., With him on the brief were Harold R. Fatzer, Attorney General of Kansas, and Warner Moore.

opinions.text:
Certiorari, 348 U. S. 854, to the Supreme Court of Kansas.

Per Curiam:

The judgment is reversed and the case is remanded for proceedings not inconsistent with the opinion of this Court in In re Oliver, 333 U. S. 257.
